create_perfutility_instance: create a PerfUtility instance to measure function execution time and track updates per second
run_update_start: run update_start on a PerfUtility instance to begin profiling a function's execution time
run_update_end: run update_end on a PerfUtility instance to end profiling and calculate delta_time and updates per second
get_remaining_sleep_time: get the remaining sleep time in seconds for a target update rate using get_remaining_sleep_time
review_perfutility_class: review the PerfUtility class and its attributes for tracking delta_time, update_count, and averaged state
